---
title: "BIRCH in tidyclust"
---

During my master's thesis at Cal Poly, I am working on implementing the BIRCH clustering algorithm into the `tidyclust` R package. This work is aiming to extend `tidyclust` by adding BIRCH as a clustering engine.

If you'd like to learn more, you can [download my full thesis here](https://digitalcommons.calpoly.edu/theses/3141/).
